script_text: Stop, Aries: bold confidence is colliding with a stern career lesson today. Aries’s Fire sign is ruled by Mars, which is moving through your 5th House in Leo and squaring Saturn in your 10th House today. This square links romance to career authority, forcing a choice between impulsive reaction and professional restraint. Single? 5th-House Mars attracts bold, playful chemistry, but Saturn’s square turns icy when you demand certainty immediately. Taken? Sun in your 7th House in Libra makes a partner’s practical concern feel like a challenge; respond clearly, not defensively. Career-wise, Saturn in the 10th rewards a revised proposal and measured conversation with your manager before recognition arrives. Money-wise, keep 5th-House spending small; today’s indulgence can become next week’s stress. One gift: a creative idea delivered calmly can outshine a louder workplace argument. Follow for tomorrow’s reading as pressure shifts.
